field_principles.adversarial_verify_clean: True iff this capstone passes adversarial_verify with no DURATION_TOO_SHORT/critical flag -- a flagged capstone does not count as a clean milestone close.
field_principles.code_native_heldout_verdict: survives_heldout_real_signal / one_point_zero_was_a_leak / not_measured -- did the AUROC=1.0 survive the held-out leak-audit?
field_principles.fr11_v13_result: Whether multi-session Tier-2 consolidation transferred to a fresh session without collapse (exp3708).
field_principles.frozen_headline_unchanged: True iff the publication gate still reads 0.9131 -- a winning candidate is a re-freeze candidate, never a silent swap.
field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: reads the gate script + artifacts; no live inference; NO compute-bound marker so it does not false-flag like exp3689).
field_principles.kv260_terminal_status: latency_transcript_captured_terminal_candidate / blocked_unreachable / not_measured -- did KV260 reach its north-star terminal anchor?
field_principles.p01_status: P0.1 stays honest-negative; do not re-assert a positive.
field_principles.paper_ready: G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 -- must remain true; the milestone does not regress the gate.
field_principles.paper_v6_forbidden_claims: Overclaims to avoid, including re-freeze headline swaps and unconfirmed code AUROC=1.0.
field_principles.refreeze_package_status: reemitted_clean_for_winner / no_candidate_beats_frozen / not_measured -- the operator-actionable re-freeze state.
field_principles.selection_diagnosis_closed: True iff the selection diagnosis was formally closed + retirement recommended (exp3707).
field_principles.shipped_detector_reconciliation: code_recalibrated_to_heldout / narrowed_to_math_only_abstain / not_measured -- was the shipped detector made honest?
field_principles.strongest_refreeze_candidate: dependency_aware / external / fusion / none -- which single candidate is strongest (exp3704), and whether a clean package was re-emitted for it.
field_principles.trained_judge_ood_retired: Records the trained-judge-OOD hypothesis as retired (exp3659).
field_principles.unmet_gates: Report which gates are unmet, not a count (publication_blocker_count is retired).
field_principles.verifier_value_scope: The scoped product claim after .339: math DISCRIMINATION (frozen headline + strongest re-freeze candidate), code (real held-out signal if survived, else math-only-with-abstain), facts RETIRED, selection CLOSED.

paper_v6_forbidden_claims: Do not cite a re-freeze candidate as the headline until re-frozen + re-reproduced.
Do not silently replace the frozen FoVer 0.9131 headline.
Do not cite a code AUROC=1.0 unless held-out-confirmed leak-free.
Do not re-assert P0.1 as positive; it remains honest-negative.
Do not re-assert facts-generalization or trained-judge-OOD; both are retired.
Do not read missing gated-task fields as None and synthesize a result around them.
Treat any AUROC >= 0.99 on n>=1000 as a leak unless explicit leak-free evidence is present.
paper_v6_safe_claims: FoVer headline remains frozen at 0.9131 AUROC with G1-G4 satisfied.
P0.1 remains honest-negative; no positive is re-asserted.
Facts-generalization and trained-judge-OOD are retired and not re-asserted.
Selection diagnosis is formally closed with operator retirement recommended.
fusion is a headline-advancement candidate with an operator-ready re-freeze package pending operator action + CI re-reproduction.
